# Variety

> Entertainment industry news and analysis covering film, television, streaming, music, awards, box office and media business.

Variety is a long-running entertainment trade publication reporting on Hollywood, global media, creators, executives, festivals, awards races and industry trends. Its site includes breaking news, reviews, business analysis, premium VIP+ coverage, event coverage, video and newsletters.

## News
- [Homepage](https://variety.com/): Main hub for breaking entertainment news, features, reviews and industry coverage.
- [Latest News](https://variety.com/v/news/): Recent reporting across film, television, music, media and awards.
- [Film News](https://variety.com/v/film/news/): News on movies, studios, casting, production and theatrical releases.
- [TV News](https://variety.com/v/tv/news/): Television industry reporting on networks, streamers, series and talent.
- [Music News](https://variety.com/v/music/news/): Coverage of artists, labels, touring, publishing and music business developments.
- [Digital News](https://variety.com/v/digital/news/): Reporting on streaming, platforms, social media and digital creators.
- [Media News](https://variety.com/v/media/news/): News about media companies, advertising, executives and corporate strategy.
- [International News](https://variety.com/v/international/news/): Global entertainment reporting spanning markets, companies and productions.

## Reviews & Criticism
- [Film Reviews](https://variety.com/v/film/reviews/): Critical reviews of new theatrical releases, festivals and major films.
- [TV Reviews](https://variety.com/v/tv/reviews/): Reviews of television series, specials and streaming originals.
- [Music Reviews](https://variety.com/v/music/reviews/): Reviews of albums, performances and music-related releases.
- [Legit Reviews](https://variety.com/v/legit/reviews/): Reviews of theater, Broadway and live performance productions.
- [Film Features](https://variety.com/v/film/features/): Reported features, interviews and analysis focused on movies and filmmakers.
- [TV Features](https://variety.com/v/tv/features/): In-depth television features, profiles and trend pieces.

## Awards
- [Awards](https://variety.com/v/awards/): Central hub for awards news, predictions, interviews and campaign coverage.
- [Awards Circuit](https://variety.com/h/awards-circuit/): Variety’s awards-season franchise with forecasts, analysis and contender coverage.
- [Oscars](https://variety.com/t/oscars/): Coverage of the Academy Awards, nominees, campaigns and race analysis.
- [Emmys](https://variety.com/t/emmys/): Reporting and predictions for the Primetime Emmy Awards.
- [Golden Globes](https://variety.com/t/golden-globes/): News and analysis around the Golden Globe Awards.
- [Grammys](https://variety.com/t/grammys/): Coverage of Grammy nominations, winners and music awards campaigns.
- [Tony Awards](https://variety.com/t/tony-awards/): Reporting on Broadway awards, nominees and theater industry impact.

## Box Office & Data
- [Box Office](https://variety.com/v/film/box-office/): Domestic and international box office news, weekend reports and analysis.
- [Film](https://variety.com/v/film/): Broader movie coverage including releases, studios and theatrical business.
- [Streaming](https://variety.com/v/digital/): Coverage of streaming platforms, audience trends and digital distribution.
- [VIP+](https://variety.com/vip/): Premium analysis on media economics, strategy, audience behavior and industry trends.
- [Media](https://variety.com/v/media/): Reporting on entertainment business performance, deals and market shifts.

## Business & Industry
- [Media](https://variety.com/v/media/): News and features on media companies, executives and corporate strategy.
- [Business](https://variety.com/v/biz/): Coverage of finance, deals, labor, legal issues and entertainment economics.
- [Digital](https://variety.com/v/digital/): Analysis of platforms, creator economy, social video and streaming business.
- [Music Business](https://variety.com/v/music/): Music industry reporting across labels, rights, touring and executives.
- [International](https://variety.com/v/international/): Global entertainment business coverage and regional market reporting.
- [Gaming](https://variety.com/v/gaming/): News and features on games, interactive media and adaptation trends.

## Festivals & Events
- [Film Festivals](https://variety.com/v/film/festivals/): Coverage of major film festivals, premieres, acquisitions and awards buzz.
- [Sundance](https://variety.com/t/sundance/): Reporting from the Sundance Film Festival and indie film market.
- [Cannes](https://variety.com/t/cannes-film-festival/): News, reviews and deal coverage from the Cannes Film Festival.
- [Toronto](https://variety.com/t/toronto-film-festival/): Coverage of TIFF premieres, acquisitions and awards contenders.
- [Venice Film Festival](https://variety.com/t/venice-film-festival/): Reporting on Venice premieres, competition titles and festival reactions.
- [Variety Events](https://variety.com/v/variety-events/): Coverage and information on Variety-hosted conferences, summits and screenings.
- [Awards Circuit Podcast](https://variety.com/t/awards-circuit-podcast/): Awards-focused interviews and analysis from Variety’s podcast franchise.

## Video & Multimedia
- [Video](https://variety.com/v/video/): Interviews, red carpet clips, trailers and original video programming.
- [Podcasts](https://variety.com/v/podcasts/): Variety podcast hub for awards, business and entertainment conversations.
- [Photos](https://variety.com/v/photos/): Photo galleries from premieres, festivals, events and celebrity coverage.
- [TV](https://variety.com/v/tv/): Television section with video, features, reviews and news.
- [Film](https://variety.com/v/film/): Movie section including trailers, interviews and festival coverage.

## VIP+ Premium Analysis
- [VIP+](https://variety.com/vip/): Subscriber analysis covering strategy, economics and entertainment market trends.
- [VIP+ Film](https://variety.com/vip/film/): Premium analysis of theatrical strategy, franchises and movie business trends.
- [VIP+ TV](https://variety.com/vip/tv/): Subscriber coverage of television economics, ratings and platform strategy.
- [VIP+ Music](https://variety.com/vip/music/): Analysis of music industry revenue, catalogs, touring and rights.
- [VIP+ Digital](https://variety.com/vip/digital/): Premium reporting on streaming, creators, platforms and digital media.
- [VIP+ Media](https://variety.com/vip/media/): Analysis of media company performance, advertising and strategic shifts.

## Newsletters & Subscriptions
- [Newsletters](https://variety.com/newsletters/): Sign-up page for Variety editorial newsletters and alerts.
- [Subscribe](https://variety.com/subscribe-us/): Subscription options for digital access and premium products.
- [VIP+ Subscription](https://variety.com/vip/): Premium membership landing page for subscriber-only analysis.
- [Magazine](https://variety.com/c/print-plus/): Print and magazine-related offerings and editorial packages.

## About & Utility
- [About Variety](https://variety.com/about/): Background on the publication, mission and brand information.
- [Contact Us](https://variety.com/contact-us/): Editorial, business and general contact information.
- [Staff](https://variety.com/author/): Author and contributor directory for Variety journalists and columnists.
- [Terms of Use](https://pmc.com/terms-of-use/): Legal terms governing use of the Variety website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pmc.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices for Variety and parent company PMC properties.
- [Advertise](https://variety.com/advertising/): Advertising and partnership information for marketers and sponsors.
